# HDR PBR transparency producer fixture

`static-hdr-blend-v1.glb` is generated by the asset server's
`examples/static_hdr_fixture.rs` at producer commit
`4035eacb582bbd268855dedf939fc2123082a722`. It contains authored geometry and a
white one-pixel PNG, with no native game assets. Regenerate and decode it with:

```sh
scripts/check-static-pbr-fixture.sh CLIENT_CHECKOUT PRODUCER_CHECKOUT hdr
```

Five quad meshes serve six instances: an opaque backdrop, red and blue lit PBR
transparent layers, a green MASK quad, an explicit unlit gold transparent layer,
and a smaller rotated/scaled instance sharing the red mesh. Metallic is zero;
roughness defaults to one, with red and blue overrides of 0.25 and 0.4. Base-color
alpha is 0.5 for red, 0.4 for blue and 0.35 for gold. The mask's vertex alpha is
0.75, its factor and texture alpha are one, and its cutoff is 0.5. The
representative mask sits above the cutoff; separate GPU tests exercise equality.

The fixture requires reader 2 and `static-visual-v1`,
`pbr-metallic-roughness-factors-v1`, `pbr-metallic-roughness-blend-v1` and
`vertex-rgba-v1`. Standard glTF PBR fields and `KHR_materials_unlit` remain
editable. Its bake revision hashes the generator source, profile identifier and
material policy. The HDR display profile is selected from explicit requirements,
rather than source names or generator text. Production package support is not
enabled by this fixture.

The binary is 7,372 bytes. SHA-256:
`a633b98e5b44f166aee5b7218673a4077a0b6f29651303ddbe043280ffd21910`.
